headline: A federal law renames a Compton, California post office building after Army Private First Class James Anderson, Jr.
what_it_does: This act gives an official name to the Postal Service facility at 101 South Willowbrook Avenue in Compton, California. The building will be called the PFC James Anderson, Jr., Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
